item.title: Pirutsiagutiit National Framework
item.description: Pirutsiagutiit, meaning "resources for growing well" in Inuktut, is a new Inuit-led program that will help Inuit children access the health, social and educational products, services and supports they need. The program will launch on April 1, 2027, replacing the interim Inuit Child First Initiative.

Our abundant natural resources, clean and reliable energy, world-class talent, strong public finances, and access to global markets give us a clear competitive advantage.
